summary: Empro Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 22, 2026, disclosing receipt of a delinquency notification from Nasdaq on May 19, 2026, for failure to file its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, violating Nasdaq Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The company has 60 days to submit a compliance plan; if accepted, it may receive up to 180 days from the original due date, until November 11, 2026, to regain compliance. Trading has been suspended since October 9, 2025. The company is working with professionals to prepare the 20-F and compliance plan. Watch for the filing of the compliance plan and potential hearing if rejected.
